RP_FLEX.name: Flexible
RP_FLEX.description: Free cancellation until 2 days before arrival; later cancellations are charged the first night. Date changes allowed, subject to availability.

RP_SAVER.name: Saver (non-refundable)
RP_SAVER.description: Discounted prepaid rate. No refund on cancellation, no date changes. Room type upgrades allowed, subject to availability.

RP_BB.name: Flexible with Breakfast
RP_BB.description: Flexible conditions plus breakfast buffet for all guests in the room.

PKG_ROMANCE.name: Romance by the River
inclusions: bottle of Moravian sparkling wine on arrival
PKG_ROMANCE.description: Deluxe King River View with breakfast, sparkling wine and a lazy morning. Flexible cancellation conditions apply.

PKG_SPA.name: Spa Recharge
inclusions: one spa day pass per guest
PKG_SPA.description: Standard Queen with breakfast and full access to the wellness area. Flexible cancellation conditions apply.

PKG_FAMILY.name: Family Weekend
PKG_FAMILY.description: Family Suite with breakfast for everyone and a kids welcome pack. Flexible cancellation conditions apply.

SVC_BREAKFAST.name: Breakfast buffet
SVC_BREAKFAST.description: Breakfast buffet in the riverside restaurant, 6:30-10:30.

SVC_PARKING.name: Underground parking
SVC_PARKING.description: Secure underground garage below the hotel. Maximum vehicle height 1.85 m.

SVC_SPA.name: Spa day pass
SVC_SPA.description: Full-day access to sauna, steam bath and relaxation pool.

SVC_TRANSFER.name: Airport transfer
SVC_TRANSFER.description: Private car between Vaclav Havel Airport and the hotel, up to 3 passengers. Book at least 24 hours ahead.

SVC_LATE_CHECKOUT.name: Late check-out until 14:00
SVC_LATE_CHECKOUT.description: Keep the room until 14:00 on departure day, subject to availability.

SVC_CRIB.name: Baby crib
SVC_CRIB.description: Baby crib for children up to 3 years, free of charge.

SVC_PET.name: Pet fee
SVC_PET.description: One dog up to 15 kg per room. Dogs are not allowed in the restaurant.

KB_CHECKIN.title: Check-in and check-out times
KB_CHECKIN.content: Check-in from 15:00, check-out until 11:00. Early arrival luggage storage is free. Late check-out until 14:00 can be purchased for 40 EUR per stay, subject to availability. Online check-in opens 2 days before arrival on the hotel website.

KB_BREAKFAST.title: Breakfast
KB_BREAKFAST.content: Breakfast buffet is served in the riverside restaurant daily 6:30-10:30. Price is 18 EUR per person per night if not included in the rate. Rates with breakfast and all stay packages include it.

KB_PARKING.title: Parking
KB_PARKING.content: Underground garage below the hotel, 24 EUR per night. Maximum vehicle height is 1.85 m. Vehicles above 1.85 m can use the public garage at Palackeho namesti, 5 minutes away, not operated by the hotel. Garage spots cannot be guaranteed without a reservation.

KB_PETS.title: Pet policy
KB_PETS.content: One dog up to 15 kg per room is welcome for a fee of 32 EUR per stay. Dogs must be leashed in public areas and are not allowed in the restaurant or spa. Other animals are not accepted.

KB_SPA.title: Spa and wellness
KB_SPA.content: Sauna, steam bath and relaxation pool, open daily 9:00-21:00. Day pass 45 EUR per person. Spa Recharge package guests have access included. Children under 15 are not permitted in the spa.

KB_POOL_GYM.title: Pool and fitness
KB_POOL_GYM.content: The indoor pool and the gym are open daily 6:00-22:00 and are free for all hotel guests. Towels are provided at the pool desk.

KB_WIFI.title: Wifi
KB_WIFI.content: Wifi is free across the hotel. Connect to the VLTAVA-GUEST network; the access code is your room number and last name, provided at check-in.

KB_TRANSFER.title: Airport transfer
KB_TRANSFER.content: Private transfer between Vaclav Havel Airport and the hotel costs 55 EUR per trip for up to 3 passengers, around 40 minutes depending on traffic. Book at least 24 hours ahead through reception.

KB_LOCATION.title: Location and getting here
KB_LOCATION.content: Hotel Vltava is at Rasinovo nabrezi 28, Prague 2, on the right bank of the river, 10 minutes walk from the Dancing House. Tram 17 stops 100 m from the entrance. From the main railway station take metro line C to Vysehrad or a taxi (about 10 minutes).

KB_CANCELLATION.title: Cancellation conditions
KB_CANCELLATION.content: Flexible rates and stay packages: free cancellation until 2 days before arrival; after that the first night is charged and the rest refunded. Saver rates are non-refundable and cannot be cancelled for a refund or moved to other dates. No-shows are charged like late cancellations.

KB_PAYMENT.title: Payment and invoicing
KB_PAYMENT.content: We accept all major cards and cash (CZK and EUR) at the hotel. A card is required to guarantee the booking; Saver rates are charged at booking, other rates at check-out. Company invoices are available at check-out, bring your company registration number.

KB_CITY_TAX.title: City tax
KB_CITY_TAX.content: Prague city fee is already included in all quoted prices. No extra local taxes are charged on departure.

KB_CHILDREN.title: Children and cribs
KB_CHILDREN.content: Children count toward the room capacity regardless of age. A baby crib for children up to 3 years is available free of charge, one per room, on request. Children under 15 are not permitted in the spa.

KB_ACCESSIBILITY.title: Accessibility
KB_ACCESSIBILITY.content: The hotel has an elevator to all floors and two wheelchair-accessible Standard Queen rooms with roll-in showers. Mention accessibility needs when booking so we can assign the right room.

KB_SMOKING.title: Smoking policy
KB_SMOKING.content: Hotel Vltava is entirely non-smoking, including balconies and terraces. Smoking in a room results in a 200 EUR cleaning fee. The nearest designated smoking area is outside the main entrance.

KB_GROUPS.title: Group bookings and events
KB_GROUPS.content: Bookings of more than 4 rooms, conferences and private events are handled by the events team, not by reception. Contact events@hotelvltava.cz; reception can transfer your request to a human colleague from the events team.
